initial_application: The request was explicitly applied by d647c65b3b in PR #2288, which added the two extension rows to the clinical reasoning extensions spreadsheet and Clinical Reasoning module page, then merged as 13fb5889ec.
additional_context: The current core build still includes the Clinical Reasoning module page and metadata type profile pages, which link through [%extensions-location%] to the Extension Pack. Core retains OIDs for both canonical extension URLs, while the authoritative StructureDefinition sources now live in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions. reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already represents the requested capability without duplicating extension definitions that have moved to the Extension Pack.
